info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cheque Processing Reviews API
info.description: The Cheque Processing Reviews API facilitates the submission and management of reviews related to cheque processing services. This allows users to provide feedback and evaluations on their experiences, contributing to service improvement and customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include banking institutions and payment facilitators looking to enhance their cheque processing operations. The API supports actions such as submitting new reviews and managing existing ones, thereby ensuring that customer insights are effectively captured and utilized.

post.summary: Create a review for a cheque payment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific cheque payment identified by its resource ID. Ensure that necessary information, such as ratings and comments, is provided in the request body to successfully create the review.
